title: setup hook with no --yes and no terminal prints the diff, refuses with exit 2 and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). The runner gives a step no terminal, so without `--yes` the command shows the preview on stdout and then refuses: `JITSO REJECTED: this changes files: read the preview above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing written`, exit 2. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stderr.regex: ^JITSO REJECTED: this changes files: read the preview above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing written\n$
